text: dsh-relay-isolation（DSH 插件，通用客户端）：为第三方模型中转服务创建独立的 DSH_HOME 与 profile，避免新建的中转环境复用主环境的会话和配置。它通过 relay_isolation 工具创建、检查或移除环境，并可探测供应商的模型列表与 API 协议；附带的 sandbox-net 提供 fetch_url，让 agent 获取允许主机上的 HTTPS 文本。适合希望将中转服务配置在单独 Harness 环境中的用户。使用前需设置供应商地址和密钥引用；setup 会向供应商端点发送探测请求。

dsh-relay-isolation creates a separate DSH_HOME for a model relay. relay_isolation sets up, checks, or removes it. Bundled sandbox-net offers fetch_url for HTTPS text from allowed hosts. Configure a provider endpoint and credential reference; setup probes it.
想给模型中转服务单独建一个 DSH_HOME。
怎么检查中转环境是否已经配置好？
I want a separate Harness home for a third-party model relay.
dsh-relay-isolation 的功能「独立中转环境」：relay_isolation 的 setup 创建或刷新独立 DSH_HOME 与 profile，status 检查状态，remove 需传入 force。
dsh-relay-isolation 的功能「网络获取」：sandbox-net 注册 fetch_url，接受 HTTPS URL 并返回文本响应；可配置允许主机和响应字节上限。
dsh-relay-isolation 使用前须知：setup 会访问配置的供应商端点以发现模型或判断 API 协议；探测请求可携带 bearer 凭据。（见 lib/provision.js:147-195）
dsh-relay-isolation 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 21 天；提交数 13；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-relay-isolation README · English：> **0.4.0 — provider-agnostic.** The plugin no longer hardcodes AgentRouter, a
> protocol, or a model list. You pass `provider` (api / baseURL / apiKeyEnv /
> models); `api: "auto"` probes `/v1/responses` and then `/v1/chat/completions`
> and records what actually works. `preset: "agentrouter"` stays available for
> that relay's endpoint switch and User-Agent fence. The host-side network tool
> moved to the standalone [`dsh-sandbox-net`](packages/sandbox-net) package, and
> a generated environment installs it automatically.

dsh-relay-isolation README · English：A DeepSeek Harness bundle that provisions **a separate `DSH_HOME`** for a
third-party model relay or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so relay traffic never
runs inside your main Harness profile.

dsh-relay-isolation README · Why a separate home, not just a separate profile：A profile only separates **plugin composition**. Sessions, storages, and
`.credentials.yaml` live in `DSH_HOME` and are shared by every profile that uses
the same home — so a relay profile in `~/.dsh` still lists your main
conversations and can read every key you stored. This plugin creates a sibling
home instead:

```
~/.dsh            main Harness: official models, your keys, your sessions
~/.dsh-relay      relay home: one profile, one key, its own sessions
```
section: Why a separate home, not just a separate profile

text:
dsh-relay-isolation README · Why a separate home, not just a separate profile：The isolated home holds **only** `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`; other credentials are
never copied.
section: Why a separate home, not just a separate profile

text:
dsh-relay-isolation README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-relay-isolation
```

dsh-relay-isolation README · Use：The bundle registers one agent tool, `relay_isolation`:

| action | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | reports whether the isolated home exists, whether its profile is configured, whether the relay route is installed, whether a key is present |
| `setup` | creates or refreshes it; idempotent |
| `remove` | deletes it, including the sessions stored there; requires `force: true` |

dsh-relay-isolation README · Use：Ask your agent: *"create an isolated relay environment"* — it calls
`relay_isolation` with `action: "setup"`. On Windows a double-click launcher is
written to the Desktop; elsewhere `~/.dsh-relay/launch.sh` is written and made
executable.

The launcher installs `dsh-llm-agentrouter` into the isolated profile on first
start, then boots `dsh` with `--port 0` and opens its own UI.

dsh-relay-isolation README · What it generates：```
~/.dsh-relay/
  .credentials.yaml            only AGENTROUTER_API_KEY
  launch.cmd | launch.sh
  profiles/relay/

The relay route and its request compatibility (client `User-Agent`, direct
transport for the domestic endpoint, tool-schema repair) come from
[`dsh-llm-agentrouter`](https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-llm-agentrouter). This
plugin configures it; it does not reimplement it.

dsh-relay-isolation README · Network inside the sandbox：The Windows sandbox hands shell commands a token without network capability, so
`curl` inside the isolated environment cannot reach anything. Raising the mode
to `danger-full-access` would fix that by removing the sandbox — the wrong trade.

Instead the bundle registers a second tool, `relay_fetch`, which performs the
request **in the host process** (unsandboxed) against an explicit allowlist:

dsh-relay-isolation README · Network inside the sandbox：| Host | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `registry.npmjs.org` | package metadata and tarballs |
| `api.github.com`, `github.com`, `raw.githubusercontent.com` | repository discovery and file reads |
| `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, `awesome-dsh-plugin.com`, `dshmarket.com` | plugin catalog |

GET only, HTTPS only, 60 KB per call by default, 20 s timeout. The write boundary
is unchanged: the sandbox still confines the agent to its workspace.

Configuration:

dsh-relay-isolation README · Network inside the sandbox：```yaml
- id: relay-isolation
  name: dsh-relay-isolation
  config:
    allowedHosts: ['registry.npmjs.org']   # replaces the default list

dsh-relay-isolation README · Permissions it gets：The isolated environment is provisioned to be **useful inside its box and unable
to reach outside it**:

dsh-relay-isolation README · Permissions it gets：| Capability | Default | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace read/write | yes | The launcher `cd`s into `<home>/workspace`; the sandbox pins `workspaceRoot` to that directory |
| Command execution | yes | Sandboxed; approval `ask` fails closed when nobody answers |
| Outbound npm / GitHub | yes | Needed to install the relay route; model traffic already goes to the relay |
| Credentials | only `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY` | Other keys in the main home are never copied |

dsh-relay-isolation README · Permissions it gets：**What it does not guarantee:** DSH's `workspace-write` bounds *writes*, not
*reads*. An agent inside the isolated environment can still read paths outside
its workspace. For a real boundary, run the launcher as a separate OS user or in
a VM.

dsh-relay-isolation README · Relay-side limits：The Responses API is stateful: a follow-up request may reference an item created
by the previous one. A relay that spreads requests across several upstream
resources breaks that, and the upstream answers *"The requested item was created
under a different Azure OpenAI resource"*. No profile setting fixes this — the
relay has to pin a conversation to one upstream. Note also that `supportsStore`
is a completions-only switch: `openai-responses` rejects it and accepts
`supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsMaxOutputTokens`, `supportsStrictMode`,
`supportsLongCacheRetention`.

dsh-relay-isolation README · Limits：- It cannot isolate the **running** host: `DSH_HOME` is fixed when a process
  starts. Isolation applies to the environment it provisions.
- The generated profile is `relay`; the generated home is
  `$(dirname $DSH_HOME)/.dsh-<suffix>`.
- Installing the relay package needs network access on first launch.
- `remove` deletes that home, including its sessions. It refuses to run without
  `force: true`, and refuses to delete `DSH_HOME` itself.

dsh-relay-isolation README · 中文：一个 DeepSeek Harness bundle，给第三方模型中转站（AgentRouter）**单独开一个
`DSH_HOME`**，让中转站流量不进入主 Harness profile。

dsh-relay-isolation README · 为什么必须是独立 home，而不是独立 profile：profile 只隔离**插件组合**。会话、存储、`.credentials.yaml` 都在 `DSH_HOME`
里，同一个 home 下的所有 profile 共用——所以 `~/.dsh` 里再建一个 relay profile，
它照样列出你的主会话，也读得到你存的每个密钥。本插件建的是**兄弟目录**：

```
~/.dsh            主 Harness：官方模型、你的密钥、你的会话
~/.dsh-relay      中转站环境：一个 profile、一个密钥、自己的会话
```

隔离环境里**只**有 `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`，其他凭据一律不复制。
section: 为什么必须是独立 home，而不是独立 profile

text:
dsh-relay-isolation README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-relay-isolation
```

dsh-relay-isolation README · 使用：装好后会注册一个 agent 工具 `relay_isolation`：

| action | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | 报告隔离环境是否存在、profile 是否已配置、中转站路由是否装好、有没有密钥 |
| `setup` | 创建或刷新（幂等） |
| `remove` | 删除，**连同里面的会话**；必须带 `force: true` |

直接对 agent 说「建一个中转站隔离环境」即可；Windows 上会在桌面写一个双击启动器，
其他平台写到 `~/.dsh-relay/launch.sh` 并加可执行位。

启动器首次运行会把 `dsh-llm-agentrouter` 装进隔离 profile，然后用 `--port 0`
起一个自己的界面。

dsh-relay-isolation README · 沙箱里的网络：Windows 沙箱交给命令的是**无网络能力**的令牌，所以隔离环境里 `curl` 连不出去。把模式提到
`danger-full-access` 能解决，但那是拿掉沙箱——方向反了。

本 bundle 注册第二个工具 `relay_fetch`：请求在**宿主进程**里发出（不受沙箱限制），目标
主机走白名单（npm registry、GitHub、插件目录），GET only、HTTPS only、默认 60 KB、
20 秒超时。写入边界不变——沙箱仍然把 agent 锁在它的工作区里。

```yaml
- id: relay-isolation
  name: dsh-relay-isolation
  config:
    allowedHosts: ['registry.npmjs.org']   # 替换默认列表

dsh-relay-isolation README · 权限模型：隔离环境是「盒子内够用、盒子外够不着」：

| 能力 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工作目录读写 | ✅ | 启动器会 `cd` 到 `<home>/workspace`，沙箱的 `workspaceRoot` 就是它 |
| 命令执行 | ✅ | 沙箱内执行；审批 `ask`，无人应答时 fail closed |
| 出网 npm / GitHub | ✅ | 装中转站路由需要；模型流量本来就走中转站 |
| 凭据 | 只有 `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY` | 主 home 里的其他 key 一律不复制 |

**它不保证的事**：DSH 的 `workspace-write` 限制的是**写**，不是**读**。隔离环境里的
agent 仍然可能读到工作区之外的路径。要拿到真正的边界，请用独立的操作系统账户或
虚拟机运行这个启动器。

dsh-relay-isolation README · 中转站侧的限制：Responses API 是有状态的：后续请求可能引用上一跳创建的 item。如果中转站把请求分散到多个
上游资源上，这一点就会被打破，上游会回 *"The requested item was created under a different
Azure OpenAI resource"*。**这不是配置能修的**——得让中转站把同一段对话固定到同一个上游。
另外 `supportsStore` 是 completions 专有开关，`openai-responses` 不接受，它只接受
`supportsDeveloperRole`、`supportsMaxOutputTokens`、`supportsStrictMode`、
`supportsLongCacheRetention`。

dsh-relay-isolation README · 边界：- 它**无法隔离正在运行的宿主**：`DSH_HOME` 在进程启动时固定，隔离对新建的环境生效；
- 中转站路由与请求兼容（`User-Agent`、国内端点直连、工具 schema 修补）来自
  [`dsh-llm-agentrouter`](https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-llm-agentrouter)，本插件只做配置；
- 首次启动需要联网安装该路由包；
- `remove` 会删掉整个 home（含会话），无 `force: true` 时拒绝执行，也拒绝删 `DSH_HOME`。
